meta.name: gemini
meta.description: Cross-model second opinion from Google Gemini — a different AI reviewing the same changes, with deep Google ecosystem knowledge. Three modes: review (pass/fail gate for Google Ads campaigns, SEO metadata, or code), challenge (adversarial stress-test that tries to break your changes), and consult (open Q&A with Gemini on Google Ads strategy, SEO best practices, or implementation questions). Use when the user says "gemini review", "ask gemini", "gemini challenge", "second opinion from gemini", "consult gemini", "stress test with gemini", "what would gemini say", "cross-model review", or "get another opinion". Voice aliases: "gem", "gemini check". Especially useful for Google Ads changes, SEO metadata updates, campaign structure decisions, keyword strategies, and bid/budget changes — Gemini has native Google ecosystem knowledge that complements Claude's analysis.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会把你的改动(如Google广告、SEO元数据或代码)整理成摘要,调用Google的Gemini AI做独立审查。根据你的要求产出三种结果:通过/不通过的结论、找漏洞的压力测试、或开放式问答建议。然后展示Gemini的意见,如Claude也看过,还会对比两者观点。
howto.when: 当你说“gemini review”“ask gemini”“gemini challenge”等关键词,或要求“另一个AI给意见”时触发。主要用于审查Google Ads、SEO元数据或代码改动。

howto.what_en: Claude packages your changes (Google Ads, SEO metadata, or code) and sends them to Google's Gemini AI for an independent review. Modes: pass/fail review, adversarial challenge, or open consult. Gemini's output is shown, with a cross-model comparison if Claude also reviewed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "gemini review", "ask gemini", or "gemini challenge" etc., or ask for a "cross-model review". Mainly for Google Ads, SEO metadata, or code changes.

say_en.text: gemini review — look at this ad keyword change for me
say_en.note: Gemini will give a pass/fail with reasons.

say_en.text: gemini challenge — stress-test this SEO title change
say_en.note: Gemini will try to find weaknesses.

say_en.text: gemini consult — ask Gemini about Google Ads bid strategy
